dataset: South-Central Delhi Green Spaces, Road Network & Candidate Corridors

geographic_coverage.extent_description: Rectangular research bounding box (~131.8 km²) spanning Central Ridge in the west, Lodhi Garden and Sunder Nursery in the central/east, and Hauz Khas / Sanjay Van fringe in the south.

green_spaces.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0

road_network.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0

provisional_cost_model.note: Hypothetical cost model for planning exploration; does not represent official Delhi government or CPWD tender rates.

methodological_limitations: Candidate routes are geometric shortest paths along OpenStreetMap street centerlines; they do not prove legal municipal planting permissions, physical underground utility clearance, or sidewalk right-of-way availability.
Road classifications are derived from OpenStreetMap tags and have not been independently verified via field survey.
Connecting two green anchors along a street candidate does not guarantee immediate biological connectivity or wildlife movement.
The bounding box is an empirical research extent (~131.8 km²) and does not correspond to an official municipal administrative boundary of South-Central Delhi.
